item.title: How to apply for TSA PreCheck and CLEAR amid long airport security lines
item.description: The ongoing government shutdown has caused a shortage of TSA agents, leading to longer security wait times at airports, but enrolling in programs like TSA PreCheck and CLEAR+ could cut your wait time.

item.title: Delta suspends special congressional desk service amid shutdown
item.description: Delta Air Lines is suspending its dedicated flight assistance service for members of Congress as airport security lines grow longer amid the ongoing partial government shutdown, according to the Atlanta Journal-Constitution.
